coverage_assessment: Captured 12 web-search invocations (45 original query strings, 380 result headers) covering general Spanish/English, four weekly windows, local/regional and agricultural, environmental, electricity-outage, social-organization and IMF issues, plus December/February boundaries. Read relevant contemporary bodies in Spanish and English and checked ENRE official context. The open-web search is not equivalent to LexisNexis and is not exhaustive; many search leads remain unread, some bodies returned technical Cache miss, one exact URL was explicitly blocked by HTTP 402, and event thresholds/response/episode boundaries remain unresolved.
